reason: I read labels and the batch report behind the QR code is what I'd actually check, and 200 mg elemental with no oxide is a real dose. At $24.99 with the empty-box refund I'd try one box, since the pre-counted sachet beats the bottle I forget on the counter.
objection: Why only one form of magnesium when others put 8 forms in one capsule? And I'd want to open the lab report and see it's real before I trust it, not just read that it exists.
would_change_my_mind: If the lab report on the page turned out to be generic or didn't match a batch number, or the lab wasn't one I could look up, I'd skip it.
